ወነበረ: ነበረ — and he stayed, remained (ወ- + 3ms perfect)
በይእቲ: ይእቲ — on that, in that (በ- + 3fs pronoun/demonstrative 'she, that')
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)
ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
በስብሐት: ስብሐት — in glory, in praise (በ- + noun)
ይኴንን: ኰነነ — he rule, judge (3ms imperfect/jussive, D)
ሕያዋነ: ሕያው — living ones (adjective used as noun, plural ሕያዋን, accusative)
ወሙታነ: ሙት — and dead ones (ወ- + noun, plural ሙታን, accusative)
ወይፈድዮ: ፈደየ — and he repays (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G ይፈድይ + -ኦ '3ms him')
ለኵሉ: ኵሉ — to all, for everything · all, the whole (ለ- marking the object before a noun: ለኵሉ ዓለም 'the whole world', after ፈጠሮ 'he created it') · ለ- marking the object, 'everyone of' before ዘ- (ያወርዶ ለኵሉ ዘሥጋ 'brings down everyone of the flesh')
ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')

ለቅድስት: ቅዱስ — for the holy (ለ- + adjective, fem. sg. ቅድስት)
ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)
ትነብር: ነበረ — she dwells, sits (3fs imperfect, n-b-r)
ዘሎቱ: ለ — to whom, whose (ዘ- + preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
